title: Glazing Fleet Management Software | Track Vans and MOTs | Coglass
description: Track your glazing vans, MOT dates and daily vehicle assignments from one place. Coglass fleet management keeps your vehicles compliant and your team moving.
lead: Assign vans to your team each day, track MOT dates and keep the paperwork with the vehicle. No missed MOT taking a van off the road.
steps_h2: Fleet management without a separate system
steps_sub: Everything you need to keep your vehicles compliant and your team mobile — built into the same system you use for jobs.
inc_h2: Fleet features built for glazing companies
inc_sub: Simple, practical vehicle management — exactly what a glazing business needs without the complexity of dedicated fleet software.
steps: Add each van with its name (e.g. "Van 1"), registration plate, make, model and MOT due date. Coglass uses this to track compliance and send you reminders before the MOT expires.
Store MOT certificates and any other vehicle paperwork in Coglass against the vehicle record.
From the planning board, put a van with each team member for the day. Staff can also pick their vehicle for the day from their phone.
Coglass alerts you when a vehicle's MOT is approaching — configurable days in advance. No vehicle goes overdue because it was forgotten among the noise of running a busy glazing business.
Every vehicle assignment is logged — who drove which vehicle on which date. Full history available for insurance queries, incident investigations or simply checking what's been used most.
When a vehicle passes its MOT, record the date it was done and the next due date, and attach the certificate. The new due date is what the reminders then count down to.
included: Store all vehicles with name, registration, make, model and MOT date in one searchable list.
MOT due dates visible at a glance. Vehicles flagged as OK, Due Soon or Overdue — colour coded for clarity.
Automatic alerts sent before MOT expiry — configurable advance warning so you always have time to book.
Upload MOT certificates and other paperwork against each vehicle.
Full record of past MOTs for each vehicle — useful for insurance, resale value and maintenance planning.
Assign a vehicle to each team member each day from the planning board.
Every vehicle assignment logged with driver and date — full audit trail for any vehicle, any time period.
Vehicle assignments show on the same planning board as staff scheduling — full operational view in one screen.
Pick the van from a phone
Staff can choose the vehicle they are driving today from their phone, which keeps the record accurate.
cta_h2: Keep your fleet compliant without the extra admin
cta_p: Book a demo and we'll walk you through it on the kind of jobs you do — or pick a plan and start a 14-day trial.
